## Columns

One row per player per game played. 37 columns. A row is identified by `game_id` + `player_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>season</td><td>string</td><td>Season the game belongs to, written like 2026.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>Part of the season: regular_season, cup_final (the Commissioner&#x27;s Cup championship game) or playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>League game id, ten digits starting with 10; keep it as text so the leading digits survive.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in U.S. Eastern time, as the league lists it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the player&#x27;s team in this game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player&#x27;s team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the opposing team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the opposing team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_away</td><td>string</td><td>home or away for the player&#x27;s team; at a neutral site, the team the league designates as home.</td></tr>
<tr><td>result</td><td>string</td><td>W or L for the player&#x27;s team; blank only for a game that was still in progress when the file was built.</td></tr>
<tr><td>player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Player&#x27;s full name as the league lists it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starter</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the player started the game; blank for the rare game with no starting lineup on record.</td></tr>
<tr><td>start_position</td><td>string</td><td>Listed starting position (G, F or C) for starters, blank for reserves.</td></tr>
<tr><td>minutes</td><td>float</td><td>Minutes played, in decimal minutes (30.5 is 30 minutes 30 seconds).</td></tr>
<tr><td>fgm</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals made by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fga</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals attempted by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fg3m</td><td>int</td><td>Three-point field goals made by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fg3a</td><td>int</td><td>Three-point field goals attempted by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ftm</td><td>int</td><td>Free throws made by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fta</td><td>int</td><td>Free throws attempted by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>oreb</td><td>int</td><td>Offensive rebounds by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>dreb</td><td>int</td><td>Defensive rebounds by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>reb</td><td>int</td><td>Total rebounds by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ast</td><td>int</td><td>Assists by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>stl</td><td>int</td><td>Steals by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>blk</td><td>int</td><td>Blocked shots by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tov</td><td>int</td><td>Turnovers by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pf</td><td>int</td><td>Personal fouls by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pts</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored by the player.</td></tr>
<tr><td>plus_minus</td><td>int</td><td>Team point differential while the player was on the court.</td></tr>
<tr><td>double_double</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the player reached 10 or more in at least two of points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks.</td></tr>
<tr><td>triple_double</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the player reached 10 or more in at least three of points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks.</td></tr>
<tr><td>dk_fantasy_points</td><td>float</td><td>Fantasy points under DraftKings classic scoring: points + 0.5 per three made + 1.25 per rebound + 1.5 per assist + 2 per steal + 2 per block - 0.5 per turnover, plus 1.5 for a double-double and 3 for a triple-double.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fd_fantasy_points</td><td>float</td><td>Fantasy points under FanDuel scoring: points + 1.2 per rebound + 1.5 per assist + 3 per steal + 3 per block - 1 per turnover.</td></tr>
<tr><td>usage_rate</td><td>float</td><td>Share of team plays the player used while on the court, in percent: 100 x (FGA + 0.44 x FTA + TOV) x (team minutes / 5) / (minutes x (team FGA + 0.44 x team FTA + team TOV)), with team totals summed from the player lines; blank for a player with no recorded minutes, and it can run far above 100 for a stint of a few seconds.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team_rest_days</td><td>int</td><td>Full days off for the team since its previous game in this file (0 is the second night of a back-to-back); blank for the team&#x27;s first game of the season.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the WNBA's official game statistics: player box scores and starting lineups. Fantasy points, usage rate and rest days are computed from those box scores by the formulas in the column descriptions.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the WNBA files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every WNBA file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season, Commissioner's Cup final and playoff game, from the official box scores and play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
